items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: He's like Elman Ziggy. When he was with Benny he was the only one that wouldn't drink.

ctx.x: He didn't touch a drop. He's like Elman Ziggy. When he was with Benny he was the only one that wouldn't drink. It used to be, get after Harry and Chris Griffin. Sometimes they would get drunk, but he wouldn't touch it.
He died an alcoholic. And Jo was always the neatest one in the band, or one of the neatest. Herschel I think was about the neatest one.
